propositions: Read-only derivations over gate sidecars expose llm_calls and latency metrics from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics only (COMPLETION_VERDICT carries no metrics block)
cost_per_accepted_change is computed as sum of llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes
first_pass_verification measures the fraction of tickets whose EARLIEST COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 record with the next same-gate PASS record (matching on gate field: plan_review/code_review/completion), computing interval as PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp, with open intervals for ERRORs having no matching PASS
Raw ordered scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files per ticket bypasses reducer helpers to count all completion passes and surface gate_error_v1 records
Metrics register into registry.py with source=sidecar and high confidence, authoritative over completion/plan-review gates
